contract_year_nfl_close_contract_year_sn.classification_evidence: No resolved wrong sign for the declared mechanism, split-half reliability not measured, and no positive control bounds an effect this small (docs/lanes/xlg-harness-power-2026-11-14.md).
contract_year_nfl_close_contract_year_sn.description: Contract-year family, contract_year_snap_share_gap: home minus away share of offensive plus defensive snaps, over the team's strictly earlier regular-season games of the same season, played by players whose latest contract signed before the season's calendar year ends that season (nflverse OverTheCap contracts). One offset-logistic coefficient per SD, leave-one-season-out, graded close, 2013-2025; declared sign positive. Changed picks 1566, record 784-782; coefficient per SD -0.0140; season halves +0.0411 and -0.0709; percentile 24.5 of 200 within-season shuffles; in-sample minus held-out +0.571945.
contract_year_nfl_close_contract_year_sn.notes: Family contract_year_family_v1: declared in docs/lanes/contract-year-2026-11-16.md before the outcome join; 1 gating log-loss read in the matched null, 3 recorded cells, 2 season-half coefficients; survivor: no.
contract_year_nfl_close_contract_year_sn.plain_summary: Checks whether teams leaning more on players in the last year of their contracts beat the spread more often. No effect large enough for this test to see showed up.
